name: What can a converted garage be used for?

mainEntity.name: What can a converted garage be used for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A converted garage offers versatile space that can be tailored to various needs. Common uses include creating an additional bedroom, a dedicated home office, a home gym, a play area for children, a media room, or an accessory dwelling unit (ADU) for rental income or extended family. The design possibilities are extensive, allowing for customization to fit specific lifestyle requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: A converted garage can be used for an extra bedroom, home office, gym, play area, media room, or an accessory dwelling unit (ADU).
